name: Reports Export completes the selected report request
description:
Objective: Reports Export completes the selected report request.
Preconditions: Open Reporting readonly with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Reporting readonly.
2. Reports Export completes the selected report request.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: Confirm the visible Export action receives a successful report response.
